decision.reason: [ev-6f2ab5d1b975] is a single changelog line saying an "env annotation" was added to the render Docker runtime container, with a link to PR 6372. It does not give the annotation key, its format or values, or whether it is optional. It also doesn't say which render setups are affected or what happens to an operator who does nothing. To write the typed assertion we need the PR content or the render documentation.
